preconditions.description: The number of plates n must be between 1 and 2000.
The maximum number of plates that can be moved from the dirty stack to the intermediate stack is a, which must be between 1 and n.
The maximum number of plates that can be moved from the intermediate stack to the dryer is b, which must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(sizes) == n and all(1 <= size <= n for size in sizes) and len(set(sizes)) == n
preconditions.description: The sizes of the plates must be distinct integers between 1 and n, and there must be exactly n sizes.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if it is possible to achieve the correct order of plates in the dryer, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: k >= 0 and all(1 <= tj <= 2 and 1 <= cj <= n for tj, cj in operations)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the number of operations k must be non-negative, and each operation must be valid with tj being 1 or 2 and cj being between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(sizes[i] < sizes[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the sizes of the plates in the dryer must be in increasing order.
